scope: One synthetic consented support ticket and three invitation-suppressed identities (customer/two staff). Real HTTP privacy, assignment, note, revision and cleanup checks; no real customer, model, embedding, PDF/OCR or email operation.
checks: Anonymous staff queue rejected
Customer cannot inspect staff queue
Customer cannot call private-note action
First staff claim uses its authenticated identity
Second staff sees another assignee
Second staff cannot double claim
Other assignee cannot send a public reply
Collaborator can add an internal note
Customer detail/list export data excludes internal metadata
Internal action preserves public timestamps, message count and retention
Opaque revision prevents stale overwrite after an internal note
Handover requires a meaningful reason
Explicit handover changes assignee and retains internal reason
Former assignee cannot release another staff member
Mine/other queue filters follow authenticated staff
Assigned staff can reply without exposing notes
Customer receives public reply only
Customer follow-up preserves private notes and assignment
Current assignee can release to unassigned queue
Audit stores actions rather than note or reason text
source_report_hash_format: SHA256 of UTF-8 canonical JSON: sorted keys, ensure_ascii=False, separators comma/colon, no trailing newline
limits: Synthetic support HTTP acceptance; no model, PDF/OCR, email delivery or real customer processing.
No new visual browser, load, restore, SLA or student authorship acceptance.
